tldr: Sun in the 6th house: identity becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With the Sun in the 6th house, this part of you develops through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
